fusions.name: Heaped and Split
fusions.desc: Rakes the nearest body within 9 tiles into a heap and splits it open; it bursts, dealing 28 damage plus a share of what it was to everything within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Long-Handled Flick
fusions.desc: A long-handled chop at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Clear the Chopping Floor
fusions.desc: Rakes up every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 6% of your health.

fusions.name: Pitch the Pieces
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, a chopped piece of it flies at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 10 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
